complaint_text: Several classrooms in our village school have broken roofs and rainwater damages the books.
The government primary school needs more teachers and two classrooms are unsafe during monsoon.
Children walk far to school because the nearby school building has collapsed.
Our school has no working toilets and students miss class to find water.
A shortage of teachers means many children in the middle school cannot get regular lessons.
The health centre is often closed and there is no doctor available for pregnant women.
People travel to another block for basic treatment because our clinic has no medical staff.
The community health centre needs a nurse and essential medicines for patients.
An ambulance takes too long to reach our village during medical emergencies.
The local hospital has no doctor on night duty and patients wait for hours.
Our hand pump has stopped working and families must walk to the river for drinking water.
There is no clean drinking water connection in the neighborhood during summer.
Water from the village well is dirty and several families have fallen sick.
The public tap gives water only once a week and the supply is not enough for households.
We need a repaired borewell because the existing pump has been dry for months.
The road connecting our village to the main market is full of potholes and unsafe for buses.
A bridge over the stream is damaged, so farmers cannot take produce to the town.
The village road becomes muddy and unusable whenever there is heavy rain.
There is no regular bus service from our block to the district headquarters.
Street lights are broken along the road and people feel unsafe after dark.
Garbage is not collected from our lane and waste is piling up near the houses.
The open drain is blocked and dirty water overflows into the street.
There is no waste pickup service and plastic is being dumped beside the pond.
Sewage from the blocked drain is causing a bad smell near the local market.
The public dustbins are overflowing and municipal workers have not collected the rubbish.
Farmers need reliable irrigation because the canal has been dry during the planting season.
The irrigation channel is broken and crops are drying in fields near our village.
Small farmers cannot get affordable seeds and fertilizer before the sowing season.
A failed irrigation pump has left several fields without water for crops.
Farmers have no nearby market to sell vegetables at a fair price.
Mobile network coverage is weak and students cannot access online learning at home.
Our village has frequent electricity cuts and the transformer has failed several times.
The electricity connection is unreliable and households lose power every evening.
Students need internet access because the mobile signal disappears inside the village.
The local transformer is overloaded and power outages interrupt small businesses.
No drinking water in our village.
Water supply is irregular.
Government school has no teachers.
Hospital has no doctors.
Roads are damaged.
